rows.text: returns 0 when `ecx` is above 0xE (unsigned), otherwise returns `022D7FD0` + `ecx` * 0xA8

starting from `a` = qword `[qword 02EBEF70]`, returns the first non-null `a` whose sign-extended word `[a+0xC]` equals `ecx` and sign-extended byte `[a+0xE]` equals `edx`, stepping to the result of the call at `003AA1F0` + 0x36 with dword `[a]`; returns 0 when `a` becomes null

takes `p` from the call at `008632E0` + 0x21 with 8; when `p` is non-null it stores the result of the indirect call at `008632E0` + 0x3D with (0, `edx`, `r8d`, 0) to qword `[p]` and stores `p` to qword `[rcx]`, otherwise stores 0 to qword `[rcx]`; returns `rcx`

notes: 008632E0: the call at + 0x3D goes through an import slot.
